hypothesis: The frozen 70-event intersection can be joined one-to-one into a complete time-correct model-ready table containing terminal winner, raw and normalized 18h market probabilities, GEFS daily aggregate features, bucket thresholds, and contamination metadata with zero leakage, duplicates, nonfinite values, or identity mismatch.

join_contract.market_probability: Preserve raw YES prices and raw sum; divide each complete positive vector by its raw sum.
join_contract.winner: Exactly one inventory bucket with terminal_yes_winner=true; winner index follows bucket order sorted by numeric lower tail/bound.
join_contract.bucket_boundaries: Parse native integer labels; Gaussian scoring thresholds use +/-0.5 native-unit continuity correction, converted to Fahrenheit for Celsius markets.
join_contract.gefs_daily_mean: Maximum geavg value across overlapping local-day blocks.
join_contract.gefs_spread_at_peak: gespr at the block selected by maximum geavg; ties use the lowest forecast step.
join_contract.gefs_max_block_spread: Maximum gespr over all overlapping blocks.
join_contract.local_day_semantics: Retain exact_partition and outside_local_seconds from the 18h GEFS inventory.
